# What can you pay for this scrap gold and still profit?

> Free scrap gold buying calculator for pawn shops and estate buyers: type the karat and weight of each piece and your refiner's terms to see the highest offer that still pays after assay loss, fees, shipping and a gold price drop. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
